Name: Agricultural Company
Author: Saebyeol
Description: Pixel Art Cleanup: replaces the 0.8.5 visual atlas with a fully transparent RGBA sprite set, clears legacy crop badges before drawing product art, standardizes machinery/process/product icon style, removes white icon rectangles, and preserves the 0.8.4 management layout, safe fallbacks, vanilla-crop production, optional Crop Genetics integration, quality/yield, contracts, brand progression, save compatibility, and equal-partner multiplayer.
